title: Event envelope
description: Common envelope for all domain events. Events carry IDs and facts, never message text or decrypted personal data (ADR-0007).

id.description: UUIDv7; consumers deduplicate by this value.

trace_parent.description: W3C traceparent for correlating with traces (ADR-0021).

data.description: Event-specific payload, validated by the schema <type>.v<version>.json.
